  • acd283a [dev] Keep the repository survey of #635 in data-raw/repo_survey (temporary) — Lakens
  • 65aea8a [link_repair] Repair links split by a space or hyphen (#411, #458); find full GitHub/GitLab links in the text — Lakens
  • 92a6574 [main] Merge pull request #633 from scienceverse/dev — Daniel Lakens

  • 1602ea5 [credit_levi_baruch] text-extractors.R: write eta and the squared sign as \u codes, as CRAN requires in R code (0.4.3.27) — Lakens
